items.title: Man in his 50s in hospital after being hit by vehicle in Etobicoke
items.summary: A man in his 50s was seriously injured when he was struck by a vehicle in north Etobicoke Wednesday night, Toronto police said.

items.title: ‘Bring it on’: Pauline Hanson to appeal Mehreen Faruqi racial discrimination ruling in high court
items.summary: One Nation leader granted special leave to appeal after full federal court earlier this year agreed Hanson portrayed Faruqi as a ‘second-class citizen’

items.title: Some permanent resident applicants left in limbo by changes to Canadian citizenship law
items.summary: CBC News has learned that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada quietly put permanent resident applications on hold for an unknown number of people who could now qualify for citizenship by descent.

items.title: The 2028 U.S. election season begins as both parties navigate midterm fallout
items.summary: The final midterm votes are still being counted, but make no mistake: The next U.S. election season has already begun.

items.title: Billionaire Leon Black sues U.S. Rep. Robert Garcia for defamation over Epstein comments
items.summary: Billionaire Leon Black on Wednesday filed a federal defamation lawsuit against California Rep. Robert Garcia for public comments the Democratic congressman made tying him to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein.
